programs.name: Ontario Health atHome
programs.for_whom: People of all ages requiring care at home, school, or in the community, including seniors and those with complex medical conditions.
programs.how_to_apply: Call 1-833-515-1234 or use the Ontario Health atHome map to find care in your area.

programs.name: Family-managed home care or self-directed care
programs.for_whom: Individuals eligible for home care services, including children with complex medical needs, adults with acquired brain injury, home-schooled children with qualifying needs, and those in extraordinary circumstances.
programs.how_to_apply: Contact Ontario Health atHome to determine eligibility and for more information.

programs.name: Ontario Drug Benefit Plan
programs.for_whom: Seniors requiring low-cost medication as part of end-of-life care at home.
programs.how_to_apply: Details not specified in the text; typically accessed through healthcare providers or pharmacists.

programs.name: Long-term care homes
programs.for_whom: Individuals needing long-term care services.
programs.how_to_apply: Explore care options, choose a home, and apply through Ontario Health atHome or the Ministry of Long-Term Care.

programs.name: Trillium Drug Program
programs.for_whom: Ontarians with high prescription drug costs compared to their household income.
programs.how_to_apply: Apply online via the Ontario Drug Benefit Program Online Applications and Forms website or request a paper copy by phone, toll-free number, or email.

programs.name: Ontario Drug Benefit program
programs.for_whom: Individuals who do not qualify for the Trillium Drug Program, such as those enrolled in Ontario Works or with full insurance coverage.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text, but mentioned as a program for which eligibility is considered when applying for the Trillium Drug Program.

programs.name: Exceptional Access Program (EAP)
programs.for_whom: Individuals needing access to specific drug products not covered under the standard Ontario Drug Benefit program.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text, but mentioned as a program providing access to additional drug products.

programs.name: OHIP+
programs.for_whom: Individuals under 25 years of age who are dependent on another person for support.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text, but mentioned as a program for which eligibility is considered in household definitions.

programs.name: Assistive Devices Program (ADP)
programs.for_whom: People with long-term physical disabilities needing customized equipment or supplies.
programs.how_to_apply: Find out more about how to qualify, apply, and find a vendor through the provided links.

programs.name: Ontario Works
programs.for_whom: Individuals receiving financial support from Ontario Works.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text.

programs.name: Ontario Disability Support Program
programs.for_whom: Individuals receiving financial support from the Ontario Disability Support Program.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text.

programs.name: Assistance for Children with Severe Disabilities
programs.for_whom: Children with severe disabilities receiving financial support.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text.

programs.name: Ontario Disability Support Program (ODSP)
programs.for_whom: Individuals and families with disabilities in financial need.
programs.how_to_apply: Apply online, over the phone, or in-person at a local ODSP office.

programs.name: Canada Disability Benefit
programs.for_whom: Individuals with disabilities receiving federal support.
programs.how_to_apply: Not specified in the text; refer to federal government resources.

programs.name: Transition Child Benefit
programs.for_whom: Recipients of Ontario Disability Support Program (ODSP) or Ontario Works with children.
programs.how_to_apply: Eligibility is assessed during the application for ODSP or Ontario Works.

programs.name: Health811
programs.for_whom: Anyone seeking health advice, including mental health and addiction concerns.
programs.how_to_apply: Visit online or call 811 to speak to a registered nurse 24/7.

programs.name: ConnexOntario
programs.for_whom: Anyone seeking information and referral to mental health and addiction services.
programs.how_to_apply: Call 1-866-531-2600, use live online chat, or email via the ConnexOntario website.

programs.name: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program
programs.for_whom: Individuals aged 18 and older with anxiety and depression.
programs.how_to_apply: Get referred by a physician, nurse practitioner, or other health care professional; self-referral available in some areas.

programs.name: Homelessness and Addiction Recovery Treatment (HART) Hubs
programs.for_whom: People with complex needs, including homelessness and addiction.
programs.how_to_apply: Visit a HART Hub location or contact the specific organization for services.

programs.name: Consumption and Treatment Services
programs.for_whom: Individuals seeking supervised drug consumption and overdose prevention services.
programs.how_to_apply: Visit a consumption and treatment service location for access to services and referrals.
